expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Sets the actor's world-space scale. Sets the interval between actor ticks. Enables input through the supplied player controller. Disables input through the supplied player controller. Enables or disables network replication. Spawns with an explicit transform and complete spawn parameters. @param SpawnParameters controls owner, instigator, template, collision, naming, and deferred construction. A null OverrideLevel uses normal dynamic/caller level resolution. Spawns with explicit parameters without inheriting the caller's streaming level. @param SpawnParameters OverrideLevel is passed through unchanged. Spawns directly in this World using the supplied complete parameter object. @param SpawnParameters is passed to Unreal unchanged, including OverrideLevel. Spawns an actor class in the current world. @param Class Actor subclass to spawn; a null class raises a script exception. @param Name Requested UObject name; NAME_None lets Unreal select the name. @param bDeferredSpawn Defers construction so properties can be assigned before Actor::FinishSpawningActor is called. @param Level Explicit destination level; nullptr tries the dynamic spawn level, then the calling actor/component level, otherwise the world's default level. Spawns without inheriting the caller's streaming level. @param Class Actor subclass to spawn; a null class raises a script exception. @param Name Requested UObject name; NAME_None lets Unreal select the name. @param bDeferredSpawn Defers construction; the caller must finish the spawn.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void Actor.SetActorScale3D(FVector NewScale3D); | void Actor.SetActorTickInterval(float32 TickInterval); | void Actor.EnableInput(APlayerController PlayerController); | void Actor.DisableInput(APlayerController PlayerController); | void Actor.SetReplicates(bool bInReplicates); | AActor Actor::SpawnActor( const TSubclassOf<AActor>& Class, const FTransform& SpawnTransform, const FActorSpawnParameters& SpawnParameters); | AActor Actor::SpawnPersistentActor( const TSubclassOf<AActor>& Class, const FTransform& SpawnTransform, const FActorSpawnParameters& SpawnParameters); | AActor UWorld.SpawnActor( const TSubclassOf<AActor>& Class, const FTransform& SpawnTransform, const FActorSpawnParameters& SpawnParameters); | AActor Actor::SpawnActor( const TSubclassOf<AActor>& Class, const FVector& Location = FVector::ZeroVector, const FRotator& Rotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator, const FName& Name = NAME_None, bool bDeferredSpawn = false, ULevel Level = nullptr); | AActor Actor::SpawnPersistentActor( const TSubclassOf<AActor>& Class, const FVector& Location = FVector::ZeroVector, const FRotator& Rotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator, const FName& Name = NAME_None, bool bDeferredSpawn = false);
